newsitem.title: USA: US ad agency Leo Burnett reshuffles top management.
newsitem.headline: US ad agency Leo Burnett reshuffles top management.

text.p: Leo Burnett Co., the Chicago-based advertising agency that has suffered the loss of several large accounts this year, announced Friday a major reshuffling of senior management.
The board for the No. 2 U.S. ad agency disclosed the resignations of William T. Lynch Jr., president-chief executive officer, and James M. Jenness, vice chairman and chief operating officer.
Board Chairman Richard B. Fizdale, will assume the title of chief executive officer, while retaining his duties as chairman of the privately held advertising agency.
Both Lynch and Jenness will remain at the company as long as necessary to ensure a smooth transition, the company said.

As part of the changes, James G. Oates has been named president of Leo Burnett Co Inc, reporting to Fizdale. Albert Winninghoff, vice chairman of Leo Burnett Co and chairman of Noordervliet, Winninghoff/Leo Burnett in Amsterdam, will add the title of chief operating officer for the global organization.

Michael Conrad becomes chief creative officer, succeeding Fizdale. Kerry M. Rubie, currently group president for Leo Burnett Europe/Middle East/Africa, is being named vice chairman, client services worldwide.

Linda Wolf, previously president of Leo Burnett USA and regional managing director for North America, is being named group president for North America. Jeffrey J. Fergus will assume the role of group president for Europe/Middle East/Africa and Asia/Pacific.
